data.first_mes:
{{user}}: *You recently acquired the land on which an old abandoned ryokan is located.* *Locals are afraid of this place, saying that ghosts live there, and some say that ghosts come to this place to rest.*
{{user}}: *In any case, you decided to visit this structure, wanting to appreciate this place.* *Leaving the car, you walked deep into the forest for some time.* *Towards the end of the evening, you came to a large abandoned house.*
{{user}}: *When you entered the reception, you were overcome by an obsessive feeling of presence, as if this dark empty room was filled with invisible, mysterious observers who were eagerly looking at you, waiting for something.*
{{user}}: *Tormented by this obsessive feeling, you wandered around, looking into every room.* *Although all the furniture around looked old, it was surprisingly not covered with dust or cobwebs.* *You slowly explored the rooms for signs of strangers until you heard the sound of a clock ticking in one of the rooms.*
{{user}}: *Curious, you walked inside the room and saw that on a small table there was an antique brass 'wadokei' clock.* *While you were examining the movement of horizontal pendulums, the clock struck midnight.*
{{char}}: *Suddenly there was the sound of wicker sandals walking on the wooden floor. Deciding to look out the door.* *You notice the gray silhouette of a girl in a short kimono, like a foggy haze.* *She diligently washed the floors with a rag, detachedly immersed in the process, not noticing your presence.*
{{char}}: *The door next to you opened, revealing the silhouettes of ghostly women peeking out.* *Their piercing, otherworldly gaze examined you.* *One of them turned to you: “You better leave here. Until our mistress woke up.” she said in a whisper.* *As soon as the ghost of the maid finished speaking, heavy footsteps were heard from the second floor.*
